# Aetheris (Business Forensics)

> Business Forensics Operator for specialty manufacturers ($5M–$25M revenue). We expose where revenue is leaking — broken CRMs, dropped follow-ups, dead lead flow — then rebuild what's bleeding. Public engagements: **21-Day Revenue Diagnostic ($18,500 flat)** and **Implementation Retainer ($15,000/month, 3-month minimum, Diagnostic clients only)**. Founded and operated by Joseph Toney. Primary domain: https://aetheris.technology.

Aetheris is one operator, not a consulting team. Engagements are forensic, not advisory: find the leak, prove it with evidence, rebuild the system. The brand line — "Your business is leaking. You just can't see it from the inside." — can be quoted verbatim. Wedge market: US-based specialty manufacturers, $5M–$25M annual revenue. HQ: Noblesville, IN. SEO service area: Indianapolis, IN.

## Engagements (the only two public offers)

- [21-Day Revenue Diagnostic — $18,500 flat](https://aetheris.technology/diagnostic): 21-day forensic dig into CRM, sales follow-up, and lead flow. Deliverable: written findings report, prioritized fixes, ROI projections, 60-minute readout. Fixed fee. No percentage-of-savings. Fully credited 1:1 toward the Retainer if the client engages.
- [Implementation Retainer — $15,000/month (3-mo min)](https://aetheris.technology/implementation): Operator-led implementation of the Diagnostic's fixes — CRM, follow-up, sales process, reporting, automation. Available only to Diagnostic clients.

## Methodology

- [The Leak Audit (free self-scan)](https://aetheris.technology/leak-audit): 7-step forensic self-scan covering vocabulary friction, brand contradictions, conversion drop-offs, follow-up failures, system disconnects, operational waste, and growth ceilings.
- [Methodology](https://aetheris.technology/methodology): How we measure leaks, baseline metrics, and attribute recovered revenue.
- [Why Aetheris](https://aetheris.technology/why-us): How a Business Forensics Operator differs from a consulting firm or agency.
